proposals.evidence: DEDR 4275 gives Tamil putu/putiya, Malayalam putu, Kodagu pudiyë, Kannada posa/hosa/hosadu and Tulu posa/posatu new; Konda pūni and Malto pune belong to the same family. These simple stems and adjectival inflections are selected; new-person nouns and loan-looking alternative stems remain unassigned. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 364 explicitly attests Tamil tāyār and Kannada tāyi/āyi mother, Kurux ayo and Malto ayya mother, Gadaba āya mother/ayal wife/asmal woman and Konda aysi mother/ayli girl. Nursery and kin terms vary in referent, so the survey gloss is retained rather than standardized to mother.
